entity.name: waozi
entity.description: Independent developer in Paraguay. I make Jungle Academy and the open-source Ziran language and Kryon UI toolkit it is built with.

projects.name: Jungle Academy
projects.description: A free, open-source learning app for babies and toddlers: 21 illustrated picture books, letters and numbers with spoken narration in English, German and Spanish, animal counting, a coloring book and jigsaw puzzles. No ads, no accounts, no tracking; the Android app asks for no permissions at all. It runs in the browser, on Android and on Linux.
